controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Thomas’s registered Galileo mosaic combines detailed images with a coarser background. Its high-pass processing reduces broad brightness differences but retains photographed shading and seams; it is not calibrated albedo. Source sampling varies greatly. Gray grid marks source-defined unprojectable surfaces. Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.
controls.summary: Photographed shadows remain and detail varies across the mosaic. Brightness is not calibrated reflectance; the grid marks gaps.
controls.title: SSI monochrome mosaic

controls.label: SSI reflectance
controls.description: These two Galileo photographs show overlapping parts of Ida’s surface. Both were taken through a green filter. The original sunlight and shadows remain visible; the grid marks areas without usable photographs.
controls.summary: These two Galileo photographs show overlapping parts of Ida’s surface. Both were taken through a green filter. The original sunlight and shadows remain visible; the grid marks areas without usable photographs.
controls.title: Calibrated Galileo photographs

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows source radius minus a 16 km reference sphere, including Ida’s broad irregular shape. This is radial height, not gravitational elevation. Brightness adds cartographic relief derived from the 2° shape grid; the displayed silhouette is simplified. Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.
controls.summary: Height relative to a 16 km sphere, from the shape model. Colors include Ida's broad form; the outline is simplified.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
